Data:Talk.visitor.ehsan.json.startdescription: 'It's good to be back. Thank you for seeing me.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.franklin.json.startdescription: '...thorough weather for this time of year. Definite weather...' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.fraser.json.startdescription: 'Librarian. I have urgent business with you.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.hire.hint.json.label: Hire a Visitor?
Data:Talk.visitor.hire.hint.json.startdescription: If I meet their price, I can hire them for a day.

Data:Talk.visitor.hire.json.label: Hire a Visitor
Data:Talk.visitor.hire.json.startdescription: I'll hire this one for a day.
Data:Talk.visitor.hire.json.comments: The employable is hired before their fee is paid! Which is OK as long as we specify their fee on their assistance version, too. This may also allow us to extend employment.

Data:Talk.visitor.hokobald.json.label: A Conversation with Magister Hokobald
Data:Talk.visitor.hokobald.json.startdescription: 'What a grim and chilly little country. I hope you've prepared a suitable welcome.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.hokobald.summer.json.label: A Conversation with Magister Hokobald
Data:Talk.visitor.hokobald.summer.json.startdescription: 'And this is what you call summer?? Pathetic. Don't make me stand around out here.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.startdescription: 'His new treasure is possessed by a malignity of Nowhere - I think perhaps the Hour they call the Rising Spider. If it is so, my usual protections will not serve against it. I hope that you can help me?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.startdescription: 'I am summoned West. I understand where I am being asked to go. I do not understand why.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.startdescription: 'This work is very special to me, Librarian - very special also to the Hour I serve. I want to be certain that the work is worthy of him. And that I do not disgrace the orchestra nor disappoint the audience! That always.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.startdescription: ''Lyterios' is the god Pan - his aspect as Deliverer. Why then 'Lyterion'? Advertising, or religion? Some would say there is, ha ha, no distinction! I would like to know more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.startdescription: 'I have been commissioned to write a piece, as a memorial… the themes are complex.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.agdis.startdescription: 'I would understand what has happened to this 'O.R', so that I can understand what he might want to happen to him.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.startdescription: 'Labhites may consume only what is found in the sky. Abecassis seems to have altered his diet. It is important that I understand how…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.startdescription: 'I have been charged to find this piebald garden in the ruins of Miah, and to pluck there a piebald rose… as a keepsake, I am told. My patron has been generous, but she is not merciful. Still this 'keepsake' business worries me. I would like to study the matter a little more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.startdescription: 'We approach the season of changes. I have grown long in history, but I remain narrow, cartographically speaking. To cross the ocean will take me far from other matters of interest. I will not go West to witness this thing unless I am certain it is worthy of my attention...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.startdescription: 'Ys itself is a place of exceptions. I wonder if the answer lies in that, or in something closer to home…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.startdescription: 'I intend to ask her of my own 'nearly now'. But before I do, I wish to understand as best I can why she has chosen to manifest in the Temple of Seven Coils.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale>  as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.startdescription: 'Beetles, they say, make their home in the ceiling vaults above, in great numbers. They lend their buzzings to the hymns. The deacon has commended their enthusiasm, but his view is not the majority one. There is some concern, I think, that he might himself begin to buzz. I am wondering if I should take a hand.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.aladi.startdescription: 'Medusa's riddle is 'What Is Not Seen?'  There is rarely only one answer to a Ligeian riddle. If I am to go to Budapest, I would go prepared.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.startdescription: 'To slay a labhite - that is difficult. To take a labhite alive - that is difficult enough to bring me here, to you, for help.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.startdescription: 'Reckoners. You shoot 'em, they go down, they get up. Stolen years soak up a bullet or two. But it's not a new problem. There'll be ways round it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.startdescription: 'England is hedged and prickled with prophecies this year. Some of them, I fear. Some of them, I doubt. I hope to find guidance here in Hush House.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.startdescription: 'The 'Unfettered Eye'. It could mean any number of things. The Illuminates of the Labyrinth have asked me to seek wisdom in the other great libraries. I hope that you can help.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.startdescription: 'My blood - the son of my nephew - is bound up somehow with the New King's Endeavour. My family and I have parted ways and I will not remind them of the shame of my desertion. But I cannot rest until I understand this business better.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.startdescription: 'I'm not over-fond of rebels - but I have an affinity with these ones. I need to know how much of what they say is true.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arthu.startdescription: 'First, I am to face Medusa and answer her riddle. Do you know it, Librarian? 'What is not seen?'  Secondly, I must survive the encounter. I hope that there is something in your collection to help me prepare.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..startdescription: 'This thing in St Mihail's Coffin. It'll get out; no doubt of it; that's its nature. Inevitable as breakfast. But what's interesting to me is where it might choose to hide, once it's out.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]
